verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own product page says it offers 2FA (alongside IP allowlisting) to keep code accessible only to authorized users, so account-level two-factor protection is a documented capability. However, the evidence is a one-line marketing claim that never names the method, so the TOTP authenticator-app specifics of this story are unproven. missing for 10: explicit documentation that 2FA uses TOTP authenticator apps, setup and recovery details for individual developer accounts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
